key.headline: Retray to high-capacity trays 1.85× passes envelope
key.request:
Engineering loop, next round. Goal: The feed will shift to about 69 wt % ethylene and the unit needs about 25 % more ethylene product from this tower at polymer-grade purity. Find what limits it and propose the change; make the design pass every engineering check. If existing internals limit, replace them with replace_unit and a new rating (vendor to confirm). Column flow amounts are written at today's throughput; the solver scales them.
The current design (verified changes: Retray PV-1767 with high-capacity trays) was re-solved and checked by the engines. These checks FAIL:
- robustness: draft (assumed values): operating envelope 1/2 scenarios pass (fails: Target, feed +10 %)
Propose physical changes that fix each failed check (equipment, ratings with a real item behind them, operating settings within documented limits), cheapest first. Return the FULL design as proposals: every earlier verified change you keep plus the new ones, so the design answer stands on its own. Do not edit a limit to pass a check. If a failure cannot be fixed with the information available, start the headline with 'UNSOLVABLE:' and say why and what data would settle it.
